correctness.rationale: For any theory, orbit degree 1 of finite algebraic tuple e over Cb means e∈dcl(Cb). Dividing independence is preserved under definable closure, so such e cannot destroy it. In Conant–Kruckman generic binary-function T_f^eq, b=q(d1,d2) names the unordered pair and Aut over Mb exchanges d1,d2, so e=(d1,d2) has degree exactly 2. Their Claim 3.2 gives a nondividing a over Mb but adjoining ordered lifts yields dividing; in the source function pattern f(a,d1)=a, f(a,d2)=d1, varying first coordinate in a base-indiscernible sequence while keeping second fixed forces inconsistent outputs. This proves the sharp degree-two existence. The bundled finite checker tests only the two permutation lifts and distinct-function-output incompatibility; compactness/QE are supplied by the published model theory.
